summary: Iteration 32 - Tenancy renewal + rent receipts + remortgage scenarios + fixed-rate end date. BACKEND pytest 17/17 PASSED (test_iteration32.py). (1) POST /api/rentals/tenancies/{id}/renew: end_date in past -> 400 'New end date must be in the future'; new_rent without rent_from -> 400 'Choose the date the new rent starts'; rent_from before tenancy start -> 400; end_date null -> stored as null (rolling), renewals array pushed; end_date in future + new_rent + rent_from stored rent_changes [{from_month,rent}] (sorted), GET /api/rentals shows schedule.due = new rent from that month, current_rent reflects latest rent, renewals history preserved; notify=true + tenant_email delivered@resend.dev -> emailed='sent'; notify=false -> emailed=null. (2) PUT /api/rentals/tenancies/{id}/rent/{month}: first log with receipts_auto=true + email -> receipt='sent'; same amount re-saved -> receipt=null (change detection via prev.paid_amount != body.paid_amount); receipts_auto=false -> receipt=null; no tenant_email -> receipt=null. Rent-after-renewal check: current_rent correctly resolves via rent_for() helper and schedule due reflects renewed amount. (3) PUT /api/project remortgage_scenarios: >3 entries -> 422 (Field max_length=3); rate=0 or rate=31 -> 422 (gt=0, le=30); fixed_rate_end '2026/01/01' -> 400 'Fixed-rate end date must be YYYY-MM-DD'; valid 3 scenarios return home_finance.scenarios each with {label (default 'Option N' when blank), rate, fee, monthly_payment, vs_current, two_year_cost, best_monthly, best_two_year} - exactly one best_monthly = min(monthly_payment), one best_two_year = min(two_year_cost); fixed_rate_end set returns fixed_rate_end and fixed_days_left; fixed_rate_end null clears both. FRONTEND (390x844) all testIDs reachable: /rentals -> created TEST_UI32 tenancy with tenancy-receipts-on/off chips (both visible, toggled on/off/on). tenancy-renew-{tid} opens renew-sheet with all required testIDs: renew-fixed, renew-rolling, renew-end-input, renew-keep-rent, renew-change-rent, renew-rent-input, renew-from-input (shown after tapping renew-change-rent), renew-notify-toggle (shown because tenant_email set), renew-save-button. Save -> toast 'Tenancy renewed · tenant emailed', end_date updated on card. Rent log month -> toast 'Rent logged' seen (receipt backend path exercised in pytest). /project-edit purpose=personal -> project-fixed-end-input, project-scen-label-{0..2}, project-scen-rate-{0..2}, project-scen-fee-{0..2} all visible. Saved with 3 scenarios (4.5%+£1500, 5.0%+£0, 5.5%+£200) and fixed_rate_end = today+30d. Dashboard -> home-finance-card + remortgage-card + home-fixed-rate text + remortgage-scenarios + fixed-rate-alert-card visible; scenario-best-monthly-0 badge (option 0 cheapest monthly) and scenario-best-2yr-1 badge (option 1 cheapest over 2yrs) rendered correctly. Re-saving fixed_rate_end = today+120d -> fixed-rate-alert-card hidden on dashboard. Final restore via API verified: purpose=investment, deposit=0, fixed_rate_end=null, remortgage_scenarios=[], target_type='BRRR Refurbishment', 0 TEST_UI32 tenancies left. NOTE: tenancy-rent-change-{id} testID in rentals.tsx:174 only renders when there is a rent change with from_month strictly > current YYYY-MM (future month). The spec implies it should appear 'after save'; it works when rent_from is in a future month but not the current month - this is a UI design choice (correct per code), flagged for awareness. No React Native red screen. Only cosmetic warnings: 'shadow* style props deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' from RN web.

issues: tenancy-rent-change-{id} indicator only renders when c.from_month > current YYYY-MM (i.e. future month) - rentals.tsx:174. If the user renews with rent_from in the CURRENT month, the card won't show the 'rent changes to X from YYYY-MM' line even though the change is persisted. Minor; may be intended (only highlight upcoming changes).

action_items: No blocking issues. OPTIONAL: Consider broadening the tenancy-rent-change-{id} predicate in rentals.tsx:174 to show when from_month >= current YYYY-MM (or latest in rent_changes) so a same-month rent change is still surfaced on the card. The current filter 'c.from_month > now.slice(0,7)' hides a change that starts in the current month.
COSMETIC: expo web preview emits deprecation warnings for shadow* and props.pointerEvents from RN web. Not functional.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/rentals.py:347 end_date guard uses max(start_date, today) correctly - prevents extending into the past AND prevents an end_date before the tenancy start.
routes/rentals.py:351-352 rent_from < start_date check is BEFORE touching rent_changes - good; prevents partial writes.
routes/rentals.py:356 rent_changes dedupe by from_month -> re-renewing with same rent_from month overwrites the previous entry rather than appending duplicates.
routes/rentals.py:358 renewals history preserves previous_end, end_date, new_rent, rent_from and 'at' timestamp - good audit trail.
routes/rentals.py:82-88 rent_for() iterates sorted rent_changes and picks the last change with from_month <= month - correct for stacked renewals.

routes/rentals.py:204 receipt change-detection: 'not prev or float(prev['paid_amount']) != body.paid_amount' prevents duplicate receipts when the same amount is re-saved. Note: a change from 500 -> 500 -> 1000 would correctly send a receipt only on the 500->1000 transition.
routes/rentals.py:362-384 renewal email only sent when notify=True AND tenant_email present; failed email returns emailed='failed' and logs the message (does not raise). Good UX.
routes/projects.py:88-96 scenario best flagging uses 'x is best' identity comparison - works because 'best' and 'best_2y' are references to items of the same scen list.

routes/projects.py:97 fixed_days_left correctly computes negative values when fixed_rate_end has passed; frontend home-finance-card.tsx:45 handles the <0 case with 'ended' label and FixedRateAlertCard.tsx:118 shows alert for d<=90 including negatives.
routes/projects.py:112-115 Scenario Pydantic model enforces 0<rate<=30 and fee>=0; ProjectUpdate.remortgage_scenarios has max_length=3 so a 4-item list returns 422.
routes/projects.py:153-159 fixed_rate_end handling uses 'in body.model_fields_set' so an explicit None clears it, matches /project-edit's isNew-only exclusion.
frontend/src/components/renew-sheet.tsx:46 request body always includes end_date (null when rolling), new_rent/rent_from (null when !changeRent), notify - matches backend RenewIn schema.
frontend/src/components/home-finance-card.tsx:71 scenario card highlights only best_monthly with a border/bg; best_two_year gets a badge but no border - acceptable but inconsistent visual weight.

frontend/app/project-edit.tsx:102 fixed_rate_end only sent in PUT (not POST /projects) via '...(isNew ? {} : { fixed_rate_end: ... })' - matches ProjectUpdate having fixed_rate_end but ProjectCreate not having it.
